en: Vintage illustrated postcard with several vignettes of Egyptian scenes. At upper right is the Great Sphinx and a pyramid. At upper left is a panoramic view of a fortified complex on a hill, including a large mosque, labeled as the citadel and mosque of Cairo. Near the center is a scene of a square with a monument and buildings, labeled as a square in Alexandria. At lower left is a portrait of a woman in traditional attire framed by a crescent. Decorative French captions and the phrase "Souvenir dʹ Egypte" appear on the card.
